classes.name: ARBs
classes.description: Losartan, valsartan, irbesartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, candesartan, azilsartan (Edarbi); single-agent tablets (combinations with HCTZ or amlodipine are alternatives only if listed separately). Sacubitril/valsartan (Entresto) is heart failure and out of scope.
classes.plainDescription: A daily blood pressure pill, often used when an ACE inhibitor causes cough.

classes.name: Calcium channel blockers
classes.description: Dihydropyridines (amlodipine, nifedipine ER, felodipine ER, nicardipine) and non-dihydropyridines (diltiazem IR/ER, verapamil IR/ER).
classes.plainDescription: A daily blood pressure pill that relaxes blood vessels.

classes.name: Beta blockers
classes.description: Metoprolol tartrate/succinate, carvedilol IR/CR, atenolol, bisoprolol, nebivolol (Bystolic), propranolol IR/ER, labetalol, nadolol.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.

classes.name: Thiazide diuretics
classes.plainDescription: A daily water pill for blood pressure.
